summary.shortDescription: A single-external-18650 regulated box mod rated at 100W and 32A.
summary.description: Geekvape documents the Aegis Solo 3 as a single external 18650 regulated mod using AS Chip 4.0. The manufacturer store gives a complete 5–100W, 7.5V, 32A, 0.1–3Ω operating envelope. An exact ECF review confirms the marketed device identity and vaping use; no independent load trace was found that would replace the stated ceiling.

claims.statement: The exact marketed identity is Geekvape Aegis Solo 3, also styled Aegis Solo III.
The manufacturer profile is one external 18650, 5–100W, 7.5V maximum, and 0.1–3Ω.
claims.limitations: Manufacturer and manual values are not independent certification.

claims.statement: The exact device has a defensible 32A maximum output-current ceiling.
claims.limitations: No controlled independent load trace was recovered; do not inherit limits from other Aegis devices.
